_meta.note: Seeded by CatalogSeeder. Adding a category here creates it; it never deletes one, because a category with products in it is not something a data file should be able to remove. Use the admin panel's on/off switch to hide a category instead — that hides its products too, reversibly. `image` must name a file that exists in assets/images/categories/ or be null: the admin renders a thumbnail when it is set and an 'Add an image' affordance when it is not, so a path to a missing file is the one value that produces a broken picture.
_meta.active: The live set is the seven launch categories: chocolates-dairy, home-decor, kitchen-appliances, dates-nuts, kids-toys, fashion-clothes, flash-sale. Every earlier category is "active": false — kept in full (slug, blurb, children, image, seeder row) so switching one back on is one boolean, not a re-authoring job. This flag is the static-site mirror of the DB's is_active column: the front end reads it in modules/catalog/backend/api.js getCategories() and shared/js/components/category-menu.js, and tools/sitemap.py skips inactive slugs. Turning one on: flip it here, then re-run tools/assemble.py and tools/sitemap.py, and add it to the hand-authored lists in shared/components/header.html + index.html.
